column1: # Genomes simulated to measure the subtype flucut names
# (benchmark/README.md, "naming the subtype of a sample"). Each one
# carries the HA of one subtype and the NA of one subtype, so that the
# 16 HA subtypes and the 9 NA subtypes are all covered, with the
# internal genes of A/Puerto Rico/8/1934 (H1N1, RefSeq): a combination
# put together here, not a sequenced isolate, which is what the
# measure needs, as only the HA and the NA decide the subtype named.
# None of the HA and NA records is in the built-in reference set, and
# each was collected in another place, host or decade than the
# references of its subtype. Accessions: segments 1 to 8 (PB2, PB1,
# PA, HA, NP, NA, M, NS), GenBank/RefSeq nucleotide; all of them begin
# with the Uni12 terminus and end with the Uni13 terminus, which
